preflight.reason: Initial raw Rust import module was unresolved in esbuild; supplied both generated namespace imports through the same explicit profile-runtime module. No browser samples from failed build. Generated duplicate module key warning retained; both aliases resolve to identical runtime.

limits: Diagnostic only; no production changes, GPU time, cold process, peak memory or speedup claim.

Timer resolution and extra imports/code generation perturb measurements; zero is not zero cost.
SH is a measured stage, not an isolated encode_ext_rgb measurement; direct encoding remains a hypothesis.
Pixel equality is against SH8+AP16 candidate, not lossless equality to original PLY; prior quality costs still apply.
